outcome.technical:
Attempt 2, on top of attempt 1's work, which stays as it was. (1) Markdown twin: _usage_markdown gained _cli_cost_text(u), which returns plain lines. It gives [] when dollars are off, when the payload has no cliCost, or when every figure agreed. When cliCost is None it gives one could-not-compare sentence carrying cliCostReason, or 'no reason was recorded' if the payload has none. Otherwise it gives a header plus one 'session S · M: CLI $x (basis) vs plugin $y' line per entry. The label is the entry's basis, which usage_ledger.cli_basis produced, so no copy of the label exists. _usage_md prints those lines under the head line, entries as a list. _report_usage._cli_cost_block now only escapes _cli_cost_text's lines (

for the failure sentence, a

(2) Could-not-compare reason: _usage_load._cli_cost now returns (entries, reason), where reason is ': ' when cli_cost_entries raises. The payload carries a new key cliCostReason beside cliCost. Before this, the branch dropped the reason: both new cases failed on the attempt-1 tree before the fix (test__usage_markdown 35/36 with counts [0, 0]; test__report_usage 110/111 with (None, '')).
